name: Fraunces
summary: Old Style soft-serif variable display typeface on Google Fonts, with weight, optical size, softness and wonk axes.
description: Google Fonts specimen page for Fraunces, a display "Old Style" soft-serif family by Undercase Type (Phaedra Charles and Flavia Zimbardi) inspired by Windsor, Souvenir and the Cooper Series. It is a variable font with four axes: weight (100-900), optical size (9-144), softness (SOFT) and wonk (WONK), with italics and latin, latin-ext and vietnamese subsets.
contains: variable font with four axes: weight, optical size, softness (SOFT), wonk (WONK)
designed by Phaedra Charles and Flavia Zimbardi at Undercase Type
